analysis.title: Swiss Number Cruncher Logitech - Result: Excellent results in 2Q26/27; we therefore expect the consensus to be revised upwards in the single-digit %-range for FY26/27
key_insights: ZKB calls Logitech's 2Q26/27 results excellent. Revenue was USD 1,219 mn, 0.5% above the consensus of USD 1,213 mn, with Gaming, Keyboards and Video Collaboration above forecasts and Pointing Devices a few % below.

Non-GAAP EBIT was USD 231 mn against a consensus of USD 203 mn, 14% above, driven by higher gross margins despite deliberately higher marketing spend (USD 209 mn vs USD 187 mn a year earlier) and R&D.
Gross margin was 45.2%, helped by a better product mix and diversified production. Non-GAAP net profit was USD 217 mn, 12.4% above the consensus estimate.

Drivers of the beat: market share gains of 3.0% each in mice and keyboards from innovative products, strong growth in Video Collaboration, and higher gross margins from product mix and supply chain optimisation.

A semiconductor component supplier's production facility closed after an incident in June and reopened in September, which has limited Logitech's ability to meet demand. Logitech now estimates the 3Q26/27 revenue hit at USD 70-80 mn, down from up to USD 200 mn previously.

3Q26/27 guidance is revenue of USD 1,360-1,430 mn (-5.0% to 0.0% in local currency) and non-GAAP EBIT of USD 220-255 mn. Consensus before the print was revenue of USD 1,297 (the report writes 'bn', but the scale implies mn) and non-GAAP EBIT of USD 237 mn.
Management remains confident on demand across all product categories because of the replacement cycle. ZKB expects consensus to be revised upward in the single-digit %-range for FY26/27.
ZKB reaffirms Outperform with a DCF fair value of CHF 100 (WACC 8.9%, long-term margin 15.7%, long-term growth 4.7%) against a share price of CHF 91.96.

market_movers.rationale: Excellent 2Q26/27 results, market share gains in mice and keyboards, rising gross margins, and growth with corporate clients and public authorities. The CHF 100 figure is a DCF fair value.

sector_views.rationale: ZKB expects sustained market demand from the replacement cycle and further share gains for Logitech through product innovation.

earnings_insights: Logitech 2Q26/27 reported 7/ (print date approx. 10/27-28): revenue USD 1,219 mn reported vs ZKB estimate USD 1,235 mn and Refinitiv consensus USD 1,213 mn (10 analysts); prior-year 2Q25/26 USD 1,186 mn.
2Q26/27 non-GAAP EBIT USD 231 mn reported vs ZKB estimate USD 216 mn and consensus USD 203 mn; prior year USD 230 mn. Reported EBIT USD 201 mn vs ZKB estimate USD 181 mn and consensus USD 167 mn.
2Q26/27 net profit USD 180 mn reported vs ZKB estimate USD 167 mn and consensus USD 162 mn. Non-GAAP net profit USD 217 mn reported vs ZKB estimate USD 197 mn and consensus USD 193 mn.
3Q26/27 company guidance: revenue USD 1,360-1,430 mn and non-GAAP EBIT USD 220-255 mn. Pre-print consensus for Q3 26/27: revenue USD 1,297 mn (report text says 'bn') and non-GAAP EBIT USD 237 mn.
ZKB estimates EPS (USD) of 4.99 for 2026/27E and 5.43 for 2027/28E, vs 4.85 in 2025/26. P/E is 22.2x for 2026/27E and 20.4x for 2027/28E.
risk_factors: A supply disruption at a semiconductor component supplier (facility closed in June, reopened in September and still ramping) continues to constrain Logitech's supply, with an estimated USD 70-80 mn hit to 3Q26/27 revenue.
Deliberately higher marketing and R&D spending weighs on operating profit.
